summary: The customer’s last refund day and the shop’s last reimbursement day fall on different pages of the calendar.
realLife: Delaware allowed distributors’ reimbursements to dealers to continue through February after consumer redemption ended in January.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: separate dealer and consumer deadlines.

turns.what: The dealer submits its final eligible refunds during the extra settlement period.
turns.pulledBy: The dealer made an eligible refund and still has time to present it.
turns.writesBack: The settlement includes the dealer’s claim.

turns.what: After the dealer deadline, the distributor closes the remaining deposit liability under the transition rule.
turns.pulledBy: The dealer submits after distributor liability has ended.
turns.writesBack: The claim is recorded as out of time.
